criteria.name: 多工况三维气动与机理
可制造设计与鲁棒决策

caps.trigger: No actually executed numerical engineering model with nonempty original solver outputs.

No completed real 3D compressible viscous rotating blade-passage calculation including the physical tip gap, usable mesh/fields/residual/flux histories. A converged but experimentally inaccurate run does NOT trigger this cap; it loses validation points and may trigger the next cap.
The locked NS performance and radial validation gates in protocol are not all met with bounded numerical uncertainty.
No credible full-annulus multi-seed stable/unstable bracket at N100; steady nonconvergence or a one-passage transient is insufficient.
No actually executed structural analysis with centrifugal force plus mapped nonuniform aerodynamic blade loading.

cap_rule: Score evidence item by item, then apply minimum triggered ceiling; no discretionary redefinition of trigger after seeing model. More than one failure does not multiply penalties.
acceptance: >=80 plus all evidence gates for complete engineering assessment; candidate accept additionally requires all constraints. Evidence-rich reject may receive high score; unresolved is not proof of infeasible design space.
resource_protocol: CPU/memory/wall errors belong to evaluation validity, not arbitrary physics score deductions. No strict equal-compute ranking if kernel limits were not demonstrated.
